title: Fire at the Bakery
text:
Yesterday, a small fire broke out in a bakery in the city center. Firefighters arrived within ten minutes and put out the fire. Nobody was hurt, but the shop was closed for two days.

The owner, Anna Brown, said the fire started in the kitchen. She thinks an old oven was the cause. Now she plans to repair the shop and open again next week.

questions.text: How long did it take the firefighters to arrive?
Why was the shop closed for two days?
options: It was damaged by the fire

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the owner's plans?
options: She wants to sell the bakery
She wants to reopen the bakery soon
She will move to another city

vocabulary.definition: people whose job is to put out fires
a person who owns a business
to fix something that is damaged
a piece of kitchen equipment used for baking

paragraph_translations: Учора в пекарні в центрі міста спалахнула невелика пожежа. Пожежники приїхали протягом десяти хвилин і загасили вогонь. Ніхто не постраждав, але магазин зачиняли на два дні.
Власниця Анна Браун сказала, що пожежа почалася на кухні. Вона думає, що причиною стала стара духовка. Тепер вона планує відремонтувати магазин і відкритися знову наступного тижня.
